summary: Backend: 7/8 pytest passed (products list/filter/get/404, profile persist, wishlist toggle+get, Nano Banana try-on end-to-end + history). Skin analyze FAILS with 500 due to invalid Gemini model name in emergentintegrations router. Frontend: onboarding hero, discover grid (2-col), category chips, product detail with Virtual Try-On CTA, wishlist empty state, profile with palette+preferences, and try-on history all render correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport.

critical.issue: 500 error: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Invalid model name passed in model=gemini/gemini-3-flash'. The model string 'gemini-3-flash' is not accepted by the emergentintegrations LLM router. Try-on works with 'gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview', but skin analyze model needs to be corrected (likely 'gemini-2.5-flash' or 'gemini-2.0-flash' for vision text-analysis, or another valid identifier). Recommend main agent web_search for the exact supported Gemini model IDs in emergentintegrations, or use `.with_model('gemini','gemini-2.5-flash')` as a safe fallback.

minor.issue: Unsplash image URL for 'Merino Turtleneck' (photo-1608744882201-52a7f7f3dd60) resolves to a Shiba Inu dog photo instead of a garment. A few other Unsplash IDs may have similar drift. Recommend swapping to reliable fashion/product images or hosting curated images in /assets.

integration_issues.issue: Because /api/skin/analyze returns 500, the real onboarding flow cannot complete via UI. Not tested end-to-end in the browser (would show error). Fix backend model name first, then retest.

issues: Spec asked for CTA text 'Begin your palette' but actual UI shows 'Enter the atelier' + 'Redo skin analysis'. Naming change is acceptable but should be aligned with PRD if the spec is authoritative.

action_items: Fix POST /api/skin/analyze: replace `.with_model('gemini','gemini-3-flash')` with a valid Gemini identifier accepted by emergentintegrations (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash' or 'gemini-2.0-flash'). Verify with a single curl after change.
(Optional) Replace broken Unsplash image URLs in SEED_PRODUCTS (Merino Turtleneck etc.) with correct garment photos.
(Optional) Align onboarding CTA copy with PRD (or update PRD to match 'Enter the atelier').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes model strings; consider putting Gemini model names in env vars for easy swapping.

logger is defined AFTER routes that use it (analyze_skin/virtual_tryon call logger.error) - works because handlers run after module init, but ordering is fragile; move logger setup above route definitions.
startup seed only inserts when count==0; if seed list expands later, existing DB won't get new items. Consider version-tagged reseed.
clean_doc is defined but redundant because Mongo queries already use projection {'_id':0}.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend auto-seeds 36 products on startup; wishlist/profile/tryon collections used in tests are cleaned/idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only skin/analyze needs re-verification after model name fix. Use `/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestSkinAnalyze` for the retest. Try-on already validated end-to-end (image successfully generated and shown on Try-On tab).
rca_of_issue: RCA: emergentintegrations routes Gemini requests via litellm which validates the model identifier against a supported list. 'gemini-3-flash' is not on that list -> BadRequestError. Reproduction: POST /api/skin/analyze with any base64 face image -> 500. Mitigation: change with_model('gemini','gemini-3-flash') to a supported Gemini vision model id (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash) in server.py analyze_skin().
